facts: one long slim tube, about 8 times as long as it is wide; top 60% is a soft matte WHITE squeeze tube, bottom 40% is the polished chrome applicator
the white tube's far end is a flat crimped seal (white, straight across), no cap there

print on the white tube, all black, serif capitals, centred: 'BLACK YUJA BEAN / LIFTING AUTO / EYE CREAM' (3 lines), then a thin black oval outline with a black 'HB' monogram inside and tiny curved 'HEVE' above and 'BLUE' below inside the oval, then 7 small lines 'YUJA WATER / BLACK SOY BEAN / MUNG BEAN / BLUE OMIJA BIO FERM / SOLUBLE COLLAGEN / AAFERM / PEPTIDE', then '15ml / 0.50 FL. OZ.'

chrome applicator: a smooth polished silver cylinder a little narrower than the tube with a thin vertical seam line, one thin matte BLACK ring band at its end, then a short polished chrome tip that narrows into a waist and flares out into a flat round end face with one tiny hole in the centre where the cream comes out
a matte BLACK cylinder cap covers the chrome tip and ring when stored (listing photos 2 and 5); in use the cap is off
cream: soft ivory-white, a small dot squeezed onto the tip
the tip vibrates by itself when the hand on the chrome and the skin close the contact; 12,000 vibrations a minute (listing photo 5); no button, no switch, no light
size: 15 ml / 0.50 fl oz; maker's dimensions not published (searched 2026-10-27); estimate about 16 cm long and 2 cm wide, about as long as a woman's hand from wrist crease to fingertip
forbid: screw cap on the white end
